text.p: The following are the leading stories in the Maltese press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Report on Malta Drydocks management criticises evolution of the yard's worker participation system. It says that what should have been workers' participation in management has effectively turned out to be total control by the workers. This has left the government with no say in the running of the yard, despite owning it. The report was commissioned by a task force set up by the government last month to tackle the debt-ridden yard's problems.

- Malta Federation of Industry wants representation on Malta Development Corporation Board. The MDC is a government agency that promotes manufacturing industry in Malta and helps the setting up of factories.
